item.angelring.gliding_ring.tooltip1: Only lets you glide: while worn, you fall slowly, like a chicken.
item.angelring.gliding_ring.tooltip2: It does not grant flight. Upgrade the ring to awaken it.
item.angelring.awakened_ring.tooltip1: Lets you fly like in creative mode, but strictly for 60 seconds.
item.angelring.awakened_ring.tooltip2: When time runs out, flight turns off and you glide down until the ring recharges.
item.angelring.awakened_ring.charge_lock: Recharging: flight unavailable until the charge is restored (stand on the ground)
item.angelring.awakened_ring.ritual1: Shift + right-click an Enchanting Table — awakening ritual
item.angelring.awakened_ring.ritual2: Requires %s experience levels. The ring becomes the Angel Ring.
item.angelring.angel_ring.tooltip: Grants creative-style flight while worn in a ring slot
item.angelring.angel_ring.desc: A relic. Grants creative-style flight. It gains experience with you; the higher its rarity, the stronger its abilities.
advancement.angelring.divine_wings.title: Божественные Крылья
message.angelring.level_ready: The ring has gathered enough experience: you can level it up!
message.angelring.not_worn: Put the Angel Ring into a ring slot (Curios) first
message.angelring.ability_locked: The active ability unlocks at ring level %s
message.angelring.flight_empty: Flight charge is empty: the ring lowers you gently. Stand on the ground to recharge
message.angelring.flight_ready: The ring is recharged: flight is available again
message.angelring.ritual_levels: The ritual needs %s experience levels (you have %s)
message.angelring.ritual_busy: A ritual is already in progress at this table
gui.angelring.subtitle: RELIC · RING SLOT
gui.angelring.level_up.ready: Enough experience. Left over after leveling: %s
gui.angelring.stat.flight.tip: Flight speed bonus from the ring's rarity (+5%% per star)
gui.angelring.reroll.tip2: Re-determines the ring's rarity, and with it all three abilities
gui.angelring.hint: Hover a card to read its description · Esc — close
gui.angelring.hint2: Ability keys: Options → Controls → Angel Ring
gui.angelring.ability.blood_ward.name: Blood Ward
gui.angelring.ability.blood_ward.desc: Passive. When you take damage, %s%% chance to block the hit, heal %s health and weaken the attacker.
gui.angelring.ability.blood_ward.short: %s%% chance to block a hit and heal
gui.angelring.ability.harvest.name: Fallen Harvest
gui.angelring.ability.harvest.desc: Passive. For every enemy you kill: heal %s, absorption for %s s and a %s%% chance of bonus experience.
gui.angelring.ability.ascension.name: Crimson Ascension
gui.angelring.ability.ascension.desc: Active (ultimate). Runes flare under your feet, enemies within %s blocks are dragged to the center, then a blast deals %s damage and stuns for %s s. Part of the damage heals you.
